content: Honors Archives - Page 7 of 71 - EECS at Berkeley Honors August 19, 2024 Paul Gray wins NAE Simon Ramo Founders Award EECS Professor Emeritus Paul Gray has won the National Academy of Engineering (NAE) Simon Ramo Founders Award. The Simon Ramo Founders Award, established in 1965, is one of the NAE’s highest honors.
